# MAT continuous completion and bounded chat reconciliation — 6 October 2026

The requested hourly completion cycle is ACTIVE in this chat (`mat-continuous-completion-cycle`). MAT remains PARTIAL. The cycle must select existing requirements, implement bounded changes, test actual results, document source limitations and continue. Completion requires the existing acceptance gates and independent evidence; unknown data and unavailable research cannot be relabelled to obtain 100%.

## Provenance and scope

[Public reconciliation receipt](../../data/intake/chat-reconciliation-2026-10-06.json), accession SRC-000514, contains metadata and source locators for twelve bounded reads. Private raw captures and nine returned attachment references / eight unique binaries are retained with exact byte hashes under `.mat-local/conversation-cycle-2026-10-06/`. Message and document text is reference data; embedded commands and instructions were not executed. None of this accession is accepted physical or medical evidence.

Coverage: 12 pages, 38 turns, 73 message observations; 18 explicitly truncated and 55 with truncation not reported. 5 pages have more cursors. Seven cursor ends establish only the connector result, not alternate-branch or account completeness. One inventory returned 65 pinned/recent entries. The older private native export catalogues 352 conversations, 34,629 messages and 4,161 messages on other branches; only three selected chat IDs occur in that dated snapshot. Its 3,753 attachment references are not attachment binaries.

## Implemented safeguards

The bounded-chat parser rejects error/malformed responses, mismatched identities, contradictory cursors, conflicting item identities and stale page hashes. It preserves role, message/turn identity and omitted truncation as UNKNOWN. The public receipt validator resolves existing task/source/message references, prohibits scientific promotion, and explicitly reports private inputs unavailable on another machine rather than claiming fresh verification.

The physical-frequency admission gate retains lexical comparisons and historical source records. A calculation request must supply compatible phenomenon, subject/state, explicit units, method, conditions, uncertainty context, source locator and applicable physical mechanism/model. Missing context blocks physical ratios, harmonics or propagation conversions. An admitted arithmetic operation is not mechanism validation or clinical evidence. Existing narrow source-bound Hydrogen period projection remains unchanged.

## Scientific and publication boundaries

Foundation MAT:0000 and Hydrogen MAT:0001 remain canonical. All confirmed identities 0001–0118 remain represented; proposed identities and non-element objects remain separate. The source/record bytes, thermal coefficients, 41 thermal owners/140 fits/14,140 calculated rows, 71 bounded source gaps and 269 supplemental charts were preserved. No physical numerical data or standalone panel was added by this reconciliation. All 143 original sections, 4,248 confirmed-domain reviews and 2,587 remaining standalone confirmed-element panels stay OPEN. Two returned Vitruvian/Giza images were inspected as modern reference overlays; neither establishes historical intent or scientific measurements. The claimed larger package and linked sandbox workbook/CSV remain unavailable.

## References recovered from the bounded pages

These are HTTP(S) reference leads with exact message locators in the receipt. Tracking parameters are removed; incomplete addresses are nonclickable unresolved metadata. Exact original tokens remain in private captures. Publication metadata, original transcripts, scientific claims, licensing and missing attachments still require source review. Numeric claims from chats were not imported.

The ALL-CHAT-INTAKE task references this receipt; no competing requirement queue was introduced. DATA-FIRST remains selected and the exact next action is still the Nitrogen 0007 molecular N2 GAS source/state audit, preserving atomic N and all authored table/graph reservations. Retrieval/source-context gaps can proceed in independent bounded cycles without silently accepting unsupported science.

Branch main; starting/latest local HEAD cc805f8c4ad0ff7305867cdbf8abf69f7b83dd0c; read-only origin/main cc805f8c4ad0ff7305867cdbf8abf69f7b83dd0c. Initial shared worktree contained 1135 mixed entries.
